intro: December is Singapore's most festive month: Orchard Road lit up for Christmas, festive carnivals at Gardens by the Bay and Sentosa, and New Year's Eve fireworks over Marina Bay. It's also the rainy season and peak travel time, so book early.

events.name: Orchard Road Christmas Light-Up
events.desc: The whole shopping street lit up, with festive mall displays and a free street party on Christmas Eve.

events.name: Christmas Train Show
events.desc: A festive model-train display at Gardens by the Bay.

events.name: Ralph Lauren Holiday Experience and ice rink
events.desc: A festive ice rink by the bay, open 10am–10pm daily.

events.name: Christmas Wonderland
events.cost: From about S$9 (advance, off-peak); about S$13 on super-peak dates
events.desc: Singapore's biggest festive carnival: light displays, a 20-metre elf treehouse, Santa's Mission Control, rides and festive food. Super-peak dates are 4–6, 11–13 and 18–27 December.

events.name: Season of Joy, A Universal Christmas and Christmas Glowcean
events.desc: Festive shows and decorations across Resorts World Sentosa, a Christmas makeover at Universal Studios Singapore and a festive glow at the Singapore Oceanarium.

events.name: Singapore Comic Con
events.desc: Comics, games, cosplay and celebrity panels.

events.name: PGL CS2 Major playoffs
events.desc: The first Counter-Strike 2 Major in Southeast Asia.

events.name: Christmas Eve street party
events.desc: Orchard Road's Christmas Eve celebration under the lights.

events.name: ONE Countdown 2027 and Marina Bay fireworks
events.where: Marina Bay, The Kallang, Siloso Beach, Clarke Quay and heartland sites
events.desc: Four-part fireworks over Marina Bay from 10.30pm to midnight, with countdown parties across the island.

tips: Book Christmas Wonderland on an off-peak weekday (27 Nov–3 Dec or 7–10 Dec) for cheaper tickets.
On 31 December, arrive at Marina Bay by 8–9pm and expect MRT crowd control.
Indian passport holders can visit Malaysia visa-free only until 31 December 2026; from 1 January 2027 a visa is needed.
